hints.title: Prefix Sum Cancellation Principle
hints.text: A consecutive slice of nodes has a sum of zero if and only if the cumulative sum before and after the slice are identical.

hints.title: Map Running Totals to Latest Nodes
hints.text: Perform an initial pass recording the latest occurrence of each cumulative prefix sum.

hints.title: Rewire Sublist Pointers
hints.text: In a second pass, reassign current node next pointer directly to latest_node[prefix_sum].next, effectively bypassing all zero-sum intermediate nodes.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def removeZeroSumSublists(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        prefix = 0
        seen = {}
        
        curr = dummy
        while curr:
            prefix += curr.val
            seen[prefix] = curr
            curr = curr.next
        
        prefix = 0
        curr = dummy
        while curr:
            prefix += curr.val
            curr.next = seen[prefix].next
            curr = curr.next
        
        return dummy.next
```

variables: N: number of nodes in linked list
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly scanning for zero-sum subarrays in a linked list can trigger quadratic passes in worst cases.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mapping prefix sums to latest occurrences enables pointer reconnection in two linear sweeps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should introduce a dummy head node to handle prefix cancellations that encompass the root.
complexity.notes: Handles cases where the entire list sums to zero.
